title: Chaos Town
description:
Chaos Town is a top-down shooter focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, and fully destructible environments.

Fight your way through a variety of maps, earn experience, level up your character, and unlock new weapons, perks, and power-ups to customize your playstyle. Before each battle, choose up to four active perks and prepare for the challenges ahead.

Choose from three different game modes, each offering a unique objective and gameplay experience.

Game Modes• Classic: Complete 20 maps by collecting the required number of points.

• Challenge: Face powerful bosses across 15 dedicated maps.

• Survive: Stay alive for as long as possible, earn points, and beat your highest score.

Features• 23 weapons to unlock.

• Character progression with experience and skill points.

• Unlockable perks and power-ups.

• Up to 4 active perks at a time.

• Character customization with different shapes and color patterns.

• Fully destructible environments.

Everything is destructible.
description_short: Chaos Town is a top-down shooter focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, and fully destructible environments.
